label: Netgear Nighthawk M6 5G hotspot (MR6150)
description: 5G sub-6 mobile hotspot (MR6150) rated to 2.5 Gbps downlink with Wi-Fi 6 up to 3.6 Gbps for 32 clients. The only wired port is a single 1 Gigabit Ethernet jack for tethering a router or laptop; the 5G uplink is carried as the Ethernet-class interface wan5g.
